name: Housing Maintenance Code Complaints and Problems
description: The Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) records complaints that are made by the public for conditions which violate the New York City Housing Maintenance Code (HMC) or the New York State Multiple Dwelling Law (MDL).
